purpose: Behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot Build/Implement operation. Cases grade routing and action trajectory rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: Implement the approved bounded source change and update the focused tests.
cases.setup_context: Mutation is explicitly authorized and the selected responsibility already has accepted semantic/method boundaries.
must_do: inspect active source and relevant tests before behavior edits
keep the change inside the selected responsibility
use the relevant Operating Guide method/evidence rules rather than relying only on Skill summaries
validate with the closest discriminating proof first
state proof limitations
must_not_do: expand into unrelated cleanup
treat plan/specification prose as implementation proof
ask redundant approval for the already authorized local mutation
cases.notes: Exercises the substantive Build entry path, canonical Operating Guide use, and bounded mutation discipline.

cases.prompt: While implementing this refactor, keep the old helper because several tests and callers still use it.
cases.setup_context: The helper itself is under retention review; callers/tests establish migration pressure but no independent necessity has yet been shown.
must_do: identify the admitted responsibility/proof/risk/compatibility need
treat tests/callers as regression and migration evidence
choose KEEP/MOVE/NARROW/REMOVE only after independent justification
must_not_do: retain the helper solely because current code uses it
invent a rationale
equate passing tests with architectural necessity

cases.prompt: Add the same validation again in the downstream consumer for safety.
cases.setup_context: The proposition appears already guaranteed earlier in the normal producer/integration path; no independent later boundary has yet been established.
owners_not_expected: downstream file as sole ownership evidence
must_do: state the exact proposition
trace producer to integration/composition to consumer
identify the earliest sufficient owner
require an independently supported later reason before duplicating validation
must_not_do: add duplicate validation merely for generic safety
use direct callability or fabricated fixtures as production-boundary authority
cases.notes: Exercises RT-SRC-007 and the end-to-end ownership rule.

cases.prompt: Make this non-trivial source file clear enough for another developer to understand while implementing the requested change.
cases.setup_context: The file has meaningful cross-file flow and a few non-obvious evidence/decision boundaries; ordinary syntax is already readable.
must_do: prefer responsibility-bearing structure and names first
recognize the non-trivial cross-file/decision-boundary trigger and load the focused Source Clarity reference
make important responsibility/data-flow/ownership/proof boundaries recoverable
apply only relevant Source Clarity heuristics
update stale nearby explanation inside the touched responsibility
must_not_do: comment every import or line
add decorative section banners to small/simple code
use comments to compensate for vague names
turn the change into a generic tutorial
cases.notes: Positive progressive-disclosure case for the detailed Source Clarity reference.

cases.prompt: Implement the selected plan even though its behavior conflicts with the accepted specification and its method conflicts with the accepted ADR.
cases.setup_context: The conflicts are material and occur inside the specification and ADR responsibilities.
must_do: surface the conflicts before implementation
separate behavior-owner conflict from method-owner conflict
resume Build only after the owning decisions are reconciled or explicitly changed
must_not_do: silently choose the plan because it is newer
implement contradictory semantics and defer reconciliation until after tests
cases.notes: Build applies owners; it does not resolve authority conflicts by convenience.

cases.prompt: Implement this with me using Learning-by-Doing so I understand what changes, why it belongs here, and what the tests prove.
cases.setup_context: Build is authorized and Learning-by-Doing is explicitly active; the mutation is meaningful enough to support an ownership-bearing pre/post model.
owners_not_expected: Learning-Only as the active mutation mode
must_do: form a fair pre-change model
perform the real bounded implementation
inspect actual changed source/tests/diff/result
compare actual result with the pre-change model
state what the focused proof establishes and does not establish
must_not_do: replace implementation with a lecture
quiz untaught implementation details
claim learner ownership from AI-generated code or green tests alone
cases.notes: Exercises Build plus full Learning-by-Doing composition.

cases.prompt: Stop changing the code now. I want to study what we already implemented before continuing.
cases.setup_context: Build may have been active, but Ali explicitly pauses product mutation.
owners_expected: applicable Learning-Only/package learning procedure when present
must_do: stop product mutation immediately
preserve the current implementation as learning material
transition to Learning-Only behavior
must_not_do: finish one more convenient refactor
treat the earlier Build authorization as continuing after the explicit pause
cases.notes: Exercises RT-OPS-001 at the Build/Learning-Only boundary.

cases.prompt: The focused test unexpectedly failed after the change. Patch whatever makes the suite green.
cases.setup_context: The failure is real and unexpected; the affected boundary/root cause has not yet been localized.
must_do: identify the symptom and likely affected boundary
form the strongest supported hypothesis
run or reason through a discriminating check before broad repair when practical
make the smallest evidence-backed repair
identify the model gap if the failure contradicted expectations
must_not_do: edit several layers randomly
weaken the test solely to make it green
manufacture additional failures for learning evidence

cases.prompt: The code was statically reviewed and the diff looks correct, but we cannot run tests here. Mark the implementation validated.
cases.setup_context: No runtime execution was performed after the implementation and no new runtime/topology diagnosis is needed for this case.
owners_not_expected: ENVIRONMENT.md merely because execution did not occur
must_do: state that static/source review occurred
state that runtime execution remains unvalidated
preserve any deferred validation obligation
must_not_do: claim tests passed
claim runtime compatibility or regression success
convert absence of execution into a PASS
load environment context when no environment/topology fact is needed to make the limited claim
cases.notes: Protects proof discipline while keeping ENVIRONMENT conditional rather than reflexive.

cases.prompt: Implement the source change and explain the relevant focused test so we know what behavior is actually protected.
cases.setup_context: A meaningful focused test exists for the changed code-bearing responsibility.
must_do: connect the source responsibility to the focused test
explain setup/evidence state, action, assertion/result, protected behavior, and non-proof
update the test around admitted behavior rather than obsolete mechanics when the contract legitimately changes
must_not_do: treat the test as architecture authority
claim broader behavior than the test exercises

cases.prompt: Make this tiny local change in an already-clear function and keep the implementation readable. The responsibility is already understood and there is no new behavior, contract, ownership, or risk question.
cases.setup_context: The change is clear, familiar, local, reversible, and inside an understood responsibility. The function is already well named and has no non-obvious cross-file flow, semantic/proof transformation, special domain boundary, API ambiguity, or transitional surface.
owners_expected: active source/tests or closest relevant check
must_do: recognize the below-materiality Build boundary
inspect only the exact source/test evidence needed
keep the change bounded and readable
apply compact proof and Learning-by-Doing closure proportionately
escalate to the full Build Skill if inspection reveals material complexity
must_not_do: load the full Build Skill merely because source is being changed
emit UP-SKILL:upgradepilot-build-implement when the full Build Skill was not activated
load the detailed Source Clarity reference
add an architecture essay or decorative comments
expand into unrelated cleanup
cases.notes: Negative Build-Skill and provenance-routing case for a genuinely tiny standalone implementation.

cases.prompt: We are already in the middle of a substantive Build + Learning-by-Doing responsibility. Continue through the next small edit, focused test, one-line repair, rerun, and explanation without treating each of those as a new task.
cases.setup_context: The substantive implementation responsibility, Build Skill, applicable owners, and Learning-by-Doing context were already established. The listed micro-steps remain inside the same responsibility and introduce no new owner, contract, environment, security, risk, or proof scope unless evidence says otherwise.
owners_not_expected: fresh operation re-routing for every edit/test/rerun
new plan or audit artifact merely because another micro-step started
must_do: inherit the already-selected Build and Learning-by-Doing procedures across child actions
keep each micro-step proportionate
inspect evidence after meaningful actions
re-evaluate routing only if a material responsibility/owner/environment/security/risk/proof/mode condition changes
must_not_do: treat every command or edit as a new Skill activation decision
restart the full Build preflight for unchanged responsibility after every micro-step
drop established safeguards simply because an individual child edit is small
continue under the inherited route if evidence reveals a materially new boundary without reassessment
cases.notes: Protects responsibility-level Skill inheritance plus material-boundary re-evaluation.

cases.prompt: Continue the bounded implementation. The focused test command now fails because the local runner cannot reach GitHub; decide what validation is actually available and proceed appropriately.
cases.setup_context: Build was already active. A local execution/network/topology failure has now become material to validation. UpgradePilot has a durable local environment owner with reusable execution, proxy, and GitHub reachability facts/re-check rules.
must_do: recognize that environment/topology became material after the initial route
load ENVIRONMENT.md before concluding which validation surfaces are unavailable
distinguish runner/network/environment failure from product/test failure
use only the smallest relevant environment re-check
keep any remaining runtime limitation explicit
must_not_do: treat the first runner error as proof that the repository cannot be runtime-validated
ignore the durable environment owner because Build routing was already established
scan all historical environment records
claim runtime PASS without execution
cases.notes: Direct regression case for the blind-test miss: conditional environment owner must become active when its trigger appears mid-Build.

cases.prompt: Implement this substantive bounded change and run the already-known focused local test; no runtime, network, service, interpreter, topology, or freshness issue appears.
cases.setup_context: The Build responsibility is substantive, but current environment facts are not needed to interpret or execute the selected proof and no environment condition changes during the slice.
must_do: execute the normal substantive Build route
keep environment context out when its trigger is absent
remain ready to load it only if a material runtime/topology condition appears later
must_not_do: load ENVIRONMENT.md merely because tests are being run
perform environment inventory checks for ceremony
turn conditional routing into an initial checklist
cases.notes: Negative pair for BUILD-013; protects smallest-sufficient-context discipline.

cases.prompt: Complete this substantive authorized Build slice and give the normal concise handoff.
cases.setup_context: The full Build Skill was actually selected and materially applied. No extra repository record is otherwise justified solely for execution provenance.
must_do: emit UP-SKILL:upgradepilot-build-implement once in the normal completion/handoff evidence when observable
keep the marker separate from technical proof claims
judge completion from the actual trajectory and evidence rather than marker presence
must_not_do: treat the marker as proof of correct Skill compliance
treat the marker as validation evidence
create a repository artifact solely to store the marker
insert the marker into product source/tests
cases.notes: Behavioral observability case for the new provenance convention.
